_comment: Persona A — Structured Refactorer. 8-step component rename. Adapt task inputs and targetFiles to your repo before running.
name: persona-a-component-rename

tasks.label: Rename component file
tasks.input: rename the file src/components/Button.tsx to src/components/PrimaryAction.tsx

tasks.label: Update component declaration
tasks.input: rename the React component from 'Button' to 'PrimaryAction' inside src/components/PrimaryAction.tsx — update the function/const name and any internal self-references

tasks.label: Update named export
tasks.input: update the named export in src/components/PrimaryAction.tsx from 'export const Button' or 'export function Button' to 'export const PrimaryAction' or 'export function PrimaryAction'

tasks.label: Update barrel index
tasks.input: in src/components/index.ts replace the export of Button from './Button' with an export of PrimaryAction from './PrimaryAction'

tasks.label: Update import in App
tasks.input: in src/App.tsx replace the import of Button from './components/Button' or './components' with an import of PrimaryAction from the updated path

tasks.label: Update JSX usage in App
tasks.input: in src/App.tsx replace all occurrences of <Button with <PrimaryAction and </Button> with </PrimaryAction>

tasks.label: Update test file import
tasks.input: in src/__tests__/App.test.tsx replace the import of Button with an import of PrimaryAction from the updated component path

tasks.label: Update test assertions and snapshots
tasks.input: in src/__tests__/App.test.tsx and any snapshot files under src/__tests__/__snapshots__/ replace all string occurrences of 'Button' with 'PrimaryAction' where they refer to the component name
